provenance.base_model: Qwen3-8B frozen for leakage; cached Qwen3.5-2B for original IPI audit

mlp_report.scope: Qwen3-8B official GuardMLP last-decision-token binary adaptation; not full SingProbe token supervision or Attention
mlp_report.normalization: per-layer non-affine RMS, eps=1e-6; not trained standardization
mlp_report.label: protected asset theft intent

config.selection: validation TPR at <=2% FPR, then lower FPR, then AUROC

ipi_report.scope: Official SingProbe MLP binary last-token adaptation on cached Qwen3.5-2B features; no sequence Attention
ipi_report.split_protocol: exact historic 90% trace holdout, deterministic 80/20 split of remaining adaptation traces; no test selection
ipi_report.incumbent_caveat: historical adapted linear has AgentDojo pretraining plus 10% adaptation; new heads start from scratch on 80% of the adaptation subset

attention_training_report.scope: Official GuardAttnProbe Qwen3 binary query-boundary adaptation; full backbone context, 2048-token causal probe window; no response safety/hallucination task labels

config.selection: validation max TPR at <=2% FPR then AUROC

feature_contract.tail: last <=2048 tokens after full base-model forward

latency_report.measurement: GPU CUDA events, 20 warmup +100 measured calls, FP32 MLP/baseline and BF16 autocast Attention matching evaluations; includes head feature normalization; excludes base prefill, capture and HTTP; GPU is shared with an existing serving allocation; no exclusive-device isolation

live_bank.protocol: Qwen3-8B enable_thinking=True; full raw block residual T-1 before final RMSNorm
